sources.role: Pinned upstream API, settings, BIOS, input, save and state implementation.
Supported systems, devices and build targets.

paths.path: No JollyCV-owned config file; Jolly Good host supplies input_coleco, mask_overscan, palette_tms9918, rsqual and region through API.
paths.naming: No persisted config grammar; configuration persistence is frontend-owned.

paths.path: Runtime jg_inputstate button[]/rel[] callbacks. Coleco paddle/roller/Super Action/steering wheel; CreatiVision paddles; My Vision system controller.
paths.naming: Physical keyboard/gamepad mapping belongs to host JG frontend.
<gameinfo.name>.srm raw ColecoVision SRAM/EEPROM sidecar; no CreatiVision/My Vision sidecar in jg.c.

paths.path: User-selected host filename; JollyCV chooses no directory or extension.
paths.naming: Raw binary JCV state: ColecoVision JCV1/50392 bytes plus active save block; CreatiVision JCV0/17501; My Vision JCV0/18558.

paths.path: Host pathinfo.bios (callback data takes precedence). coleco.rom for ColecoVision; bioscv.rom for CreatiVision; none for My Vision.
paths.naming: coleco.rom 8192 bytes MD5 2c66f5911e5b42b8ebe113403548eee7; bioscv.rom 8192 bytes MD5 3b1ef759d8e3fb4071582efd33dd05f9.
